data.title: Panora Reports Continued Compliance With Portfolio Limits
data.description:
Panora Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. ( (TR:PAGYO) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Panora Gayrimenkul Yatırım Ortaklığı A.Ş. is a real estate investment trust focused primarily on real estate, real estate-based projects and related rights, supported by money-market investments and subsidiaries. Its portfolio is heavily concentrated in domestic real estate assets, reflecting its core market focus.

The company reported that all portfolio limitation tests for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, remained within regulatory thresholds. Real estate-related assets represented 96.8% of total assets against a minimum of 51%, while leverage was 9.5% against a 500% ceiling; foreign exposure, idle land, and related-party receivables were zero, indicating continued regulatory compliance and a conservative balance sheet.

data.title: RUSAL Pays 133.6 Million Rubles in Bond Coupon Interest
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from United Co RUSAL ( (HK:0486) ).

RUSAL is a major aluminum producer supplying primary aluminum, alloys, and related products to global markets. Its operations span the aluminum value chain, positioning it prominently in the nonferrous metals industry.

On November 6, 2026, RUSAL paid 133.6 million rubles in coupon interest on its BO-001P-10 exchange-traded bonds, covering the 26th coupon period. Holders of all 10 million bonds received 13.36 rubles each, with interest calculated using the Bank of Russia key rate plus a 2.25% spread.

data.title: Zylox-Tonbridge Proposes Vascular Stake Acquisition and H-Share Issue
data.description:
Zylox-Tonbridge Medical Technology Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:2190) ) has provided an announcement.

Zylox-Tonbridge Medical Technology focuses on vascular intervention across neurovascular, peripheral vascular, aortic and structural heart disease treatments, serving Chinese and global markets. The company has proposed transactions designed to broaden its scale and market presence across these four therapeutic segments.

Under the agreements, the company will indirectly obtain an effective 10.0% interest in the Target Company through a 60.0% stake in Lighthouse SPV, which will hold approximately 16.7% of the Target Company’s voting rights. Separately, GL Lighthouse Three has agreed to subscribe for new H shares at HK$22 each, a premium to recent market prices; the issuance would represent 10.8% of enlarged shares and is classified as a discloseable transaction exempt from shareholder approval.

data.title: Amex Gold Mining Named Québec Entrepreneur of the Year
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Amex Gold Mining Inc ( (TSE:AMX) ).

Amex Gold Mining has been named Entrepreneur of the Year by the Québec Mineral Exploration Association, recognizing its leadership and progress at the Perron Gold Project in Québec’s Abitibi region. The award follows the company’s 2025 Discovery of the Year recognition and highlights its advancement from exploration toward development.

Amex has completed a feasibility study, funded a 40,000-tonne bulk sample program and begun underground ramp construction at Perron. The recognition enhances the company’s profile within Québec’s mineral exploration sector as it advances a high-grade gold project while continuing exploration across its extensive regional property holdings.

data.title: Finint Fund Takes Over 5.95% Stake in Redelfi
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Redelfi S.p.A. ( (IT:RDF) ).

Redelfi, a Genoa-based energy-transition infrastructure group listed on Euronext Growth Milan, said 714,700 shares formerly held through the Algebris HI PMI Innovative fund are now held by the Finint PMI Innovative ELTIF fund after a management transfer and name change. Finanziaria Internazionale Investments SGR, which manages the renamed fund, owns 5.95% of Redelfi’s share capital, leaving the stake size unchanged.

The updated structure leaves founder Davide Sommariva as the largest shareholder with 32.93%, followed by Alkemia SGR at 13.04%, while free float accounts for 41.45%. The disclosure clarifies Redelfi’s ownership structure following the fund transition and confirms continued institutional participation in the company’s energy-transition strategy.

data.title: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals Announces Warrant Inducement Financing Agreement
data.description:
60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ( (SXTP) ) just unveiled an update.

On November 5, 2026, 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals entered inducement agreements with holders of warrants covering 584,492 common shares, who agreed to exercise them for cash at $0.90 per share. In exchange, the company agreed to issue unregistered warrants covering 1,168,984 shares, or twice the number of shares underlying the exercised warrants.

The $0.90 exercise price implied aggregate gross proceeds of $526,042.80, with net proceeds designated for working capital and general corporate purposes. The placement arrangement provided H.C. Wainwright with 7.5% and 1% fees, $10,000 in expenses, and warrants for 43,837 shares; the new warrants required stockholder approval before exercise and had 24-month or five-year terms measured from the later of approval and resale-registration effectiveness.
